title: Eco-design rules through a pinned plugin
summary: The convention for using the green-claude plugin (sobriety rules from RGESN and GR491, with a deterministic audit) as a plugin pinned at a reviewed commit: what it changes in a session, how its findings are reported and where a dismissed one is recorded. Nothing is copied from the plugin.
postInstall: Read the green-claude repository in full at one commit, then install the plugin and record `green-claude@green-claude` in scripts/reviewed-plugins.json (docs/conventions/eco-design.md § Setting it up). Until then the module installs a rule and nothing that applies it.
The plugin's audit script needs jq on each machine that runs it.
Decide once whether the project takes the plugin's optional hooks: they are wired per person, outside the repository, and PL-1 does not see them (docs/conventions/eco-design.md § Hooks).
This convention has never been run live by the kit's authors: do the live check of the page once.
